# Beautyvee’s Dreadlock’s

> Loc specialist based in Austin, Texas. Vee makes human-hair and synthetic loc extensions by hand and installs them herself, plus retwists, detox and takedowns, faux locs and color, in a private studio on Ferguson Lane.

- Phone: (512) 417-2758
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Pflugerville, Manor, Round Rock, Hutto
- Google rating: 4.8 from 29 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/beautyvees-dreadlocks/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/beautyvees-dreadlocks/book.html

## Services
- Retwist, style & color: Vee's most popular appointment: a fresh retwist, a style, and color if you want it.
- Handmade loc extensions: Human-hair and synthetic (kanekalon) dreadlock extensions, made by hand in your color, size and length.
- Permanent & temporary installs: Extensions installed by Vee, for good or just for a season.
- Detox, takedown & removal: A deep loc detox, a careful takedown or extension removal when you're ready for a change.
- Faux locs: Faux loc installs for the look of long locs without the wait.
- Color & yarn wraps: Bright color on locs and extensions, plus yarn wraps for a pop of color without dye.

## About
Beautyvee’s Dreadlock’s is Vee's private loc studio in Suite A at 2000 Ferguson Lane in northeast Austin: warm wood floors, window light, a couch, and one chair where your locs get her full attention. No crowd, by appointment. In her words: “Our business specializes in making handmade human and synthetic dreadlock extensions that you can get installed by us as well. We offer a wide selection of colors to choose from including size and length.” Clients call her the “dread doctor.” Her most popular service is a retwist, style and color, and she also does detox, takedowns, faux locs and yarn wraps, from fire red and copper tips to a full rainbow. What reviewers mention most: a clean, well set-up space, appointments that run right on schedule, impeccable work, and walking out feeling like their hair is healthy, styled and new.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday 9 a.m. to 6 p.m., and Saturday 9 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Closed Sunday. By appointment: call (512) 417-2758 to book.
- Q: Where is the studio?
  A: 2000 Ferguson Ln, Suite A, Austin, TX 78754, in northeast Austin. The studio is wheelchair accessible.
- Q: Do you make loc extensions?
  A: Yes. Vee makes human-hair and synthetic (kanekalon) dreadlock extensions by hand, in a wide choice of colors, sizes and lengths, and installs them permanent or temporary.
- Q: Do you take loc takedowns?
  A: Yes. Vee does careful takedowns, extension removal and loc detoxes, and can install faux locs right after if you want a new look.
- Q: Can you color my locs?
  A: Yes. All-over color, tips and ombré, blond, burgundy, fire red, even full rainbow sets, plus yarn wraps for a pop of color without dye.
- Q: Do you take cards?
  A: Yes, credit cards are accepted, and there is free Wi-Fi while you sit.
